 📋 Brazil name Rayan and Endrick in starting XI to face Singapore 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Brazil's lineup has been confirmed for the friendly against Singapore, kicking off at 7 a.m. (Brasília time) in the Asian country.
 Following the defeat to Japan, coach Carlo Ancelotti has made several changes for Brazil's final test of 2026.
 OneFootball Videos
 Singapore 0 Brazil 7 Today Full time The team will line up with: Lucas Perri, Vanderson, Jonathan Jesus, Gabriel Magalhães, Douglas Santos; João Gomes, Bruno Guimarães , Rayan; Estevão, Endrick and Vini Jr.
 The main changes are Rayan, who has been confirmed in an attacking midfield role, and Endrick, who will start in place of the suspended Raphinha. Bruno Guimarães will captain the side.
 Ancelotti, who was sent off against Japan, will also be absent from the bench. His assistant will take charge of Brazil.
